environment.description: ECS Fargate service running in a private VPC subnet with an internet-facing ALB (no WAF attached). The ALB forwards all traffic on port 443 to the target group on port 8080. Session cookies are set with SameSite=None for cross-origin admin panel access from a separate domain. No CSRF token middleware is configured. Kafka cluster is MSK in the same VPC.

config.network: ALB -> ECS port 8080, no IP restrictions
config.kafka: MSK in same VPC, plaintext auth
